top_signals.title: Healey Needs £35 Billion to Meet UK Spending Plans, IFS Says
top_signals.summary: UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey must find £35 billion ($46 billion) to meet the Labour government’s spending ambitions, the Institute for Fiscal Studies warned ahead of the budget later this month.

top_signals.title: NZ National Party Will Wait for Budget Surplus Before Tax Cuts
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s ruling National Party says the nation’s debt burden and budget deficit mean now is not the time to cut taxes.

top_signals.title: Why Japan's 7-Eleven store closures in India don’t signal an exit
top_signals.summary: 7-Eleven store closures point to a reset of its operations in India, not to an exit.
